author: Yffe
content: Failing test at forge/tests/divergence_struct_inv_spec_fn_subprogram.rs::struct_inv_naming_user_spec_fn_certifies_l3 (#[ignore]d, tracking this issue) demonstrates the divergence: the #229 Counter fixture's struct cert is L0 (E0425 cannot find function s_dec — the def is absent from the emitted per-item unit — AND the emitted cast is the as u64 fallback because the item-alone sub-program has no spec fn to feed spec_fn_param_type_map), though the WHOLE-PROGRAM lowering is correct since c116360c (the thermite-lower #229 pin emits as u32). Authority: thermite-design.md §6 (correct source certifies L3) + verus-lowering.md REQ-8 (bank_account verified-struct precedent); the hand-woven pub-open form of the exact fixture is '1 verified, 0 errors' under verus. Fix shape: weave reachable_spec_fn_deps (the #68/#71 SpecFn/Fn-arm precedent) into the Struct/Enum arm; ALSO requires #230 (bare 'spec fn' is private to the pub open well_formed — verus 'in pub open spec function, cannot refer to private function', hand-confirmed). NOTE for #230: its E0425 citation is actually THIS slicing bug; the privacy layer surfaces only after weaving.
